Good Morning All,

The NerdOctaxe was packaged and shipped on Tuesday.

Thank you all for your time in resolving this item. Understood on the refund. As for a possible replacement. would it be possible to get a Magic Miner 40T or Harlo B30 as a replacement?  I fully understand if not but had to ask.

Thanks again for your time.

Respectfully,
Chris S. from my iPhone

Good morning Chris,

Thanks for getting it on its way so quickly, and for the note. I can see the return label moving, tracking ····, heading to our Chattanooga warehouse. Nothing else for you to do on that part.

On a replacement: yes, that is possible. Both of those are a step up from the NerdOctaxe, so the $694.37 comes off the price and you would cover the difference, nothing more.

The Magic Miner 40T is $799, so $104.63 difference. It is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by Dec 7, 2026.

The Harlo B30 is $899, so $204.63 difference. Also a pre-order, it ships by Nov 30, 2026.

Tell me which one you want and I will set it up and send you the invoice for the difference. Your replacement is reserved from that moment and goes out once your NerdOctaxe reaches us and the pre-order batch lands. If you would rather keep the $694.37 as store credit and decide later, that is fine too, it goes on your account as soon as the unit arrives with us.

You can follow the incoming batches here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Thanks again for your patience on this one, Chris.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
